# MIX

> MIX is an entertainment venue in Mt Pleasant, SC featuring duckpin bowling, arcade games, yard games, axe throwing, and a full bar with food service.

MIX Bar combines classic arcade entertainment with modern recreational activities like duckpin bowling and axe throwing, offering both casual drop-in play and curated party packages. The venue includes The Speakeasy, a themed private event space, and serves cocktails, beer, and food in a social gaming atmosphere.
